newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Statoil ponders 5 bln Skr in Sweden - paper.
newsitem.headline: Statoil ponders 5 bln Skr in Sweden - paper.

text.p: Norwegian state-owned petroleum group Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) may invest up to five billion Swedish crowns in Sweden, Swedish daily Dagens Industri said on Friday.
"The traditional service station will be replaced by mini-shopping centres to be called Statevilles, in which the petrol pump plays a secondary role," the newspaper said.

"The revamping of the service stations and the creation of a totally new image could require an investment of up to five billion crowns, according to Dagens Industri sources," the daily said. "The project may be launched this year."
